changelog: Say "add emojis" / "emojify" — or "ইমোজি যোগ করো" / "ইমোজি দাও" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole message gets relevant emojis added in one pass through Gemini, with your own API key. Your words stay exactly as they are — only emojis are added. A message that already has emojis is left alone.
